name: Dattopant Thengadi Artisan Interest Subsidy Scheme
benefit:
**Financial Assistance**

- A maximum credit limit of ₹1,00,000/- is available for machinery or working capital (raw materials) or both.
- Intended Use: This financial assistance is provided to purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, and machinery for the development of existing or new businesses.

**Margin Money Subsidy**

- 20% of the loan amount for General Category (Male) beneficiaries.
- 25
_eligibility_text: **General Eligibility** - The applicant must be more than 18 years of age. - The applicant must have an Identity card issued by the Development Commissioner Handloom/Handicraft/Indext-C. - The applicant must have skills in Handloom or Handicraft art. - The applicant must be registered as an artisan in urban as well as rural areas of the State with the Indext-C of the Cottage and Rural Industries Department. **Relaxation/Inclusions** - The applicant may be a Physically Handicapped or Blind Artisan, who can also avail the benefits of this scheme. - The applicant may hold a Provisional Certificate as an artisan issued by the General Manager, District Industries Centre, if they do not possess an Identity Card from the Development Commissioner.
